/**
 * Resolve Hugo Extended at the pinned version. Local dev: PATH/mise only.
 * CI: download into .cache/hugo/<version>/ when missing (Linux / Windows).
 */
import { chmodSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { arch, platform } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { capture, projectRoot, run } from "./spawnUtil.mjs";

const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

export function readPinnedHugoVersion() {
  return JSON.parse(
    readFileSync(join(__dirname, "deploy-versions.json"), "utf8"),
  ).hugo;
}

function parseHugoVersion(stdout) {
  const line = (stdout || "").trim();
  if (!/extended/i.test(line)) return null;
  const match = line.match(/v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
  return match ? match[1] : null;
}

/** Same major.minor (patch drift OK on local macOS). */
function sameMinor(a, b) {
  const pa = a.split(".").map(Number);
  const pb = b.split(".").map(Number);
  return pa[0] === pb[0] && pa[1] === pb[1];

You’re pinned on **Hugo Extended 0.163.3** (`.mise.toml` / `scripts/deploy-versions.json`). [v0.164.0](https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/tag/v0.164.0) (2026-07-06) is a small step up. Here’s what matters for this repo.

### Worth caring about

| Change | Impact here |
|--------|-------------|
| **Build perf fix** (regression since 0.128.0) | Highest upside. Large garden (~1.5k+ pages) is exactly the case they call out. Worth benchmarking if you bump. |
| **`resources.PostProcess` deprecated → `templates.Defer`** | Low risk. You already use `templates.Defer` in `layouts/baseof.html` / theme. No `PostProcess` usage found. Warnings only if a vendored module still calls it. |
| **Chroma dark/light style pairs** | Optional. You pin `markup.highlight.style = 'monokai'`. No break; later you could regenerate styles for dark/light code blocks. |
| **Case-insensitive template lookup** | Small win for Windows/Linux consistency (fits your cross-platform filename rules). |
| **`.Render` errors if template missing** | Unlikely to bite. You mostly use `RenderString`, not `.Render "layout"`. If something does call `.Render` with a bad name, builds fail loudly instead of silently. |
| **esbuild 0.28.0 → 0.28.1** | Tiny. You use `js.Build` for search bundling; patch bump, unlikely to change output. |

### Probably irrelevant here

- **Pandoc citations** — you use Goldmark, not Pandoc  
- **`markup.rst.syntaxHighlight`** — no reStructuredText content  
- **`encoding.HexEncode` / `HexDecode` / `crypto.Hash`** — new helpers only if you want them  
- **`Page.Render` subpaths** — nice API, unused today  
- **Alias path suffix fix** — only for non-`.html` suffixes (e.g. `.htm`); your aliases are normal HTML redirects  

### Bottom line

No forced template rewrites for an upgrade. The real reason to move is **faster builds** on this size of site. Everything else is optional (Chroma dark/light) or noise (Pandoc/RST).

Upgrade path if you want it: bump `0.163.3` → `0.164.0` in `deploy-versions.json` + `.mise.toml`, then compare `hugo --minify` wall time before/after.
